rationale: Shirley bridges ML research and developer tools with hands-on product experience (PM at Zoom), while JD is building 404s as a web3 developer-tools founder with a proven ability to blend coding with creative community-driven projects. They share Python and JavaScript in their stack, and both operate in developer-tools and consumer-focused spaces—JD's conviction that 'coding can be used creatively and humorously' plus his builder accessibility focus could mesh well with Shirley's side projects spanning AI productivity and web applications.
intro_message: Shirley Li, meet JD — you both code across developer tools and consumer products (Shirley via AI/web apps, JD via 404s), and might spark ideas on making technical tools more creative and accessible.
